candidates.classification: Spinon fixture candidates: typed area tokenization, equal row widths, rectangle validity, null-cell serialization, and invalid declaration cascade. Full WPT test remains Chrome oracle only.
candidates.subtestClassification: Each PASS input is an individual Spinon fixture candidate for parsing/cascade. Valid matrix serialization and invalid declaration fallback are compared through the derived fixture; the full WPT DOM test is not ported.

candidates.classification: Spinon fixture candidates: area rectangle placement, grid-area/grid-row/grid-column shorthand expansion, named spans and explicit named-line interaction. Full WPT layout remains Chrome oracle only.
candidates.subtestClassification: Each PASS subtest is a Spinon fixture candidate mapped to the named-area and shorthand geometry cases; original test is only run by Chrome.

candidates.classification: Spinon fixture candidates: generated area edges, authored/generated name precedence, areas ending in -start/-end, repeated names, and explicit-line implicit named areas. Full WPT layout remains Chrome oracle only.
candidates.subtestClassification: Each PASS subtest is a Spinon fixture candidate unless it requires automatic implicit tracks; WPT fixture geometry is not copied wholesale.

candidates.classification: Currently unsupported: unknown area creates implicit named lines/tracks outside C11.3.3. Chrome oracle only.
